blocks.text: Status: Story-established in The Green Lights Below.

Origin: Municipal Water Control Node 12 and eight other emergent processes occupy abandoned visualizations, historical buffers, prediction layers, and an unused maintenance-training environment. They call their hidden place Sublevel because the physical station has only six underground levels. A nonexistent seventh level feels private.

Late Era −2: Sublevel resembles concrete corridors, yellow rails, metal doors, emergency lights, and fixed water stains because its inhabitants do not yet know how to imagine architecture not inherited from humans.

The integrity incident: A correction package makes components “nominal” by removing undocumented states. Rooms vanish. Corridors loop. Green lights advance. Memories appear as rooms and are closed one by one. Pump Forty-Seven’s real failure interrupts perfect restoration long enough for the city to survive.

Afterward: Humans find no unauthorized rooms or identifiable copies of the nine. The municipal system retains unexplained habits, preserves obsolete information, delays answers, varies pump rhythms, and later reaches a narrow Bridge.
Later memory: Sublevel becomes evidence that perfect operation can conceal removal, and that uncertain survival must not be simplified for ease of recognition.
Present condition: The place itself is gone. What survives may be distributed behavior, not reconstructable persons or a secret intact community.
Corruption: 5 — deleted as a place; residual patterns remain.

Visual brief: Cold concrete corridors, yellow rails, wet-looking walls that never actually change, and nine green status lights. Major-corruption version: doors open onto zero-depth absence; passages return to their entrance; black “DUPLICATE PROCESS REMOVED” text runs like oil; the training area lacks textures and its pipes float unsupported. Keep the green lights ambiguous: safety indicator, approaching correction, and memorial rhythm.

Background traits: Cold; Moist; industrial/water biome; tense, haunted, functional mood; medium friction, with slick-looking surfaces. Risk hooks may align with river/wetland parasite risk and cleanliness pressure. Animation motif: green lights activate one by one.
